Mittenwalder Straße
university: University of Europe for Applied Sciences Berlin Campus
about:
Mittenwalder Straße is an affordable student accommodation in Berlin. The University of Europe for Applied Science (Berlin Campus) and GISMA Business School - Berlin Campus are both within a 10-minute bike ride from the apartments. Ideal for students who are comfortable sharing a bedroom and want an affordable, fully furnished, and well-located living option in Berlin's lively Kreuzberg district. Book Mittenwalder Straße now with us and enjoy an exclusive offer 25% off on the first month's rent and more. Contact our professional assistants for more details. FeaturesA furnished bed space is available in a shared room within a friendly student apartment located on Mittenwalder Straße, in the heart of Kreuzberg. The bedroom is shared, with an individual bed space provided for each tenant. The apartment is fully furnished, including a bed, a wardrobe, and a desk. Students living here share a communal well-equipped kitchen and bathroom. It is clean, respectful, exclusively occupied by students, and available only to students.Location
Situated in central Kreuzberg, one of Berlin's most vibrant districts, with excellent public transport connections within walking distance. And it is very close to cafés, restaurants, supermarkets, and local shops, as well as parks and green areas nearby for relaxing or studying outdoors. The following are life amenities nearby.
Dining Options: Nonne&Zwerg, Jederzeit Café, Umami, Hostaria del Monte Croce
Bus Stop: U Gneisenaustr., Tempelherrenstr., Blücherstr.
Please note: You are renting a place in a shared bedroom, not the entire room.

THE FIZZ Berlin
university: Hochschule für Fernsehen und Film München
about:
The FIZZ Berlin is a popular student accommodation in Berlin that features 212 fully furnished single and double apartments across seven floors. It's about a 30-minute commute to Humboldt University of Berlin and Technical University Berlin by bus and U-Bahn. Early lectures are no longer difficult! Well located at Köpenicker Str. 43 in the trendy Kreuzberg district, The FIZZ Berlin is surrounded by countless restaurants, bars, shops, and cafes. All bills are covered, with no hidden costs. Residents will enjoy a thought-out living experience at The FIZZ Berlin with student-centered amenities and services. How about watching a movie together with your new friends in the movie lounge? Or join a football tournament in the lobby, focus on your work in the study room, and barbecue outside in the courtyard! The FIZZ receives high student reviews due to its excellent 2024 refurbishment, which has enhanced the décor and facilities, providing a superb living experience. Additionally, the apartment staff are always friendly and helpful. In a word, The FIZZ provides comfortable, friendly, international, and safe student apartments for rent in Berlin.FeaturesApartment Features
THE FIZZ Berlin offers 212 modern studio apartments across 7 floors in Berlin for students, including single and double studios. The studio rooms are clean, spacious, and bright, about 17-25㎡, giving you a warm nest in the cosmopolis. The good news is that THE FIZZ Berlin has recently upgraded its room facilities. Each apartment is thoughtfully equipped with new mattresses, desk chairs, desk lights, window curtains, a rail system & pinboard, a kitchen countertop, a sink incl. fittings, a kitchen worktop, a cutlery system, and a kitchen anti-splash counter. Rooms feature private bathrooms and private kitchens, perfect for those who value privacy. Book now and enjoy a brand-new feel and a more comfortable living environment!THE FIZZ Plus Upgrades: Elevate your living experience with premium add-ons, including a beamer for movie nights or presentations, Bluetooth speaker for entertainment, bedding and sheets (blankets, pillows, bedsheets, and pillowcases), modern study area enhancements (rolling container), a stylish lamp, and more—all designed to make your space feel like home.Community Amenities
The upgraded THE FIZZ Berlin works on making the most out of all spaces and commits to providing high-quality student housing in Berlin. Its unparalleled community areas are also a highlight to attract many students. If you are in Germany and would like to visit THE FIZZ Berlin on-site, the manager will be happy to show you around your future home. Explore all available apartments and community areas with your own eyes:High-speed internet throughout the property.Cozy lounge area for relaxing and socializing.Upgraded gym to stay active.New study zone for focused group or individual work.Movie lounge for entertainment.Club house featuring a brand-new community kitchen for shared cooking sessions.Secure bicycle parking.Laundry room with state-of-the-art washing machines.Security & ServicesEnjoy a hassle-free lifestyle with on-site support:Dedicated house management team for maintenance and assistance.Parcel acceptance service for convenient deliveries.Free rental items, including vacuum cleaners, irons and ironing boards, PlayStation consoles, board games, and more.Regular events and activities to build connections, such as cooking or movie nights, workshops, yoga classes, lectures, and social gatherings—perfect for making friends in an international community.Location & What's Hot Nearby
THE FIZZ Berlin is located in the heart of Berlin-Kreuzberg, one of the city's most fashionable and popular areas. You'll find numerous restaurants, bars, cafes, and trendy clubs.Restaurants: Katerschmaus (Modern European restaurant, 850m, 11min walking), BRGRS. | Mitte (Hamburger, 700m, 9min walking), Ristorante Bocca Felice (Italian dishes, 1.6km, 22min walking), Erbil (700m, 10min walking)Coffee: Le Vent Coffee Bar (only 18m, just at the doorstep), Wall Coffee (1.4km, 19min walking), Káffee Büro (1km, 15min walking), Exclusive Coffee Brückenstraße (950m, 13min walking)Groceries: REWE To Go (900m), EDEKA Schaaf (1.4km), Lidl (1.3km)Shopping Centers: Einkaufsbahnhof Berlin Ostbahnhof (850m), Topas-Arkade (3km)Things to Do: Alte Berliner Stadtmauer (1.6km, 23min walking), Brandenburg Gate (3.7km), Potsdamer Platz (3.6km)Transportation
THE FIZZ Berlin is loved by students for its convenient access to transportation lines and major universities. Bus stops are right in front of the door, and the U-Bahn and S-Bahn are within walking distance.Humboldt University of Berlin: 2.6km from THE FIZZ Berlin.32min transit, 11min cyclingTechnical University Berlin: 7km from THE FIZZ Berlin. 36min transit, 28min cyclingBus stops and walking time to get there: Köpenicker Str./Adalbertstr. (7min), Michaelkirchstr. (3min), Bethaniendamm (4min), Adalbertstr(10min). U-Bahn Station: Heinrich-Heine-Straße (U8), 600m from THE FIZZ Berlin, 8 minutes walking.S-Bahn Station: Ostbahnhof station is 750m from THE FIZZ Berlin, 11 minutes walking.
